description: This file contains functions for generating account balance timeline data for a dashboard chart in an ERP system, including data retrieval, processing, and date calculations.

methods.name: build_result
methods.description: Builds a timeline of account balances over specified dates based on GL entries and account type.

methods.name: get_gl_entries
methods.description: Retrieves all GL entries for an account and its descendants up to a specified date.

methods.name: get_dates_from_timegrain
methods.description: Generates a list of period-ending dates between from_date and to_date based on the specified time grain.
